svg.title: NET-05-S — Pre-winner authoritative score overlay
svg.desc: Existing Tab score overlay on a 1280 by 900 client before a round winner. Retain the existing lower-left score-panel placement, fixed identity labels, and bounded result viewport. Optional truthful position text is non-actionable because this overlay has no supported scroll handlers. No menu canvas, banner, completed-data fixture, new focus target, or new shortcut. Top-left diagram coordinates.

g.text: Only result rows actually available from the current state
No completed-result fixture or invented empty-state message
[Diagram annotation: bounded body; no supported scrolling]
[Optional truthful row / column position; plain non-actionable text]
Session only scores • Optional scripts disabled
ANNOTATIONS — placeholders describe existing content; they are not new UI copy.
Read identity → section → columns → body → optional position text. No enabled scroll-arrow affordance.
Tab retains its existing toggle. Do not add scroll handlers, focus targets, shortcuts, or completed rows.
At smaller supported clients retain current placement and contain the body above network status.
NET-05 / UX-NET-05-006–008. Actual functional state and available values govern capture.
